headline: Binance and Polymarket Hit by Major Cyberattack Totalling $5.5B
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance suffered a hack estimated at $5.5 billion, marking the largest cyberattack in crypto history. Prediction market platform Polymarket was also breached on the same day.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume; security breaches of this scale can undermine market confidence and prompt intense regulatory scrutiny.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Major exchange security compromises typically reduce liquidity and elevate counterparty risks across digital assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The unprecedented $5.5 billion breach at Binance and an attack on Polymarket raised urgent systemic and counterparty risk concerns across crypto markets.
